slides.heading: HEADROOM & LOOK ROOM
slides.subheading: Give subjects space in the direction they're looking

slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Headroom and nose room control breathing space around a subject.
Too much headroom feels amateur; too little feels cramped.

slides.heading: FRAMING SPACE
slides.caption: Give subjects space in the direction they're looking.

slides.heading: HOW TO APPLY IT
steps: Place eyes on the upper third.
Leave space in front of the face.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Less nose room creates tension—use intentionally.
